title: Red Hat Security Advisory: python-jwt security update
description: A security vulnerability in the Python JWT library (pyjwt) was identified where it accepts unknown 'crit' header extensions, violating RFC 7515 section 4.1.11. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-32597 and affects certain Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extended Lifecycle Support packages. The vulnerability has been rated as having an important security impact by Red Hat. A security update is available to address this issue.
